findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range'
findings.expected: When the stats request fails (500), the page shows a visible error and a way to retry
findings.actual: The page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range / Pick a different date range, or log a harvest' with no error, so a server failure looks like the garden has no harvests

findings.title: Reversed date range (From after To) shows empty state instead of the server's validation message
findings.expected: The 422 reason 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' (or similar) is shown
findings.actual: The 422 is ignored and the page says 'No harvests in this range'

findings.title: Malformed stats response crashes rendering and leaves 'Loading stats…' stuck over stale data
findings.expected: An unreadable response gives a visible error, no uncaught exception, and no stuck loading text
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'; 'Loading stats…' stays forever while the old 1 Jan–31 Dec table is still shown under From=1 Mar
